name: audit_security
description: Performs comprehensive multi-language security & vulnerability health audit. Scans code for SAST security antipatterns (Command Injection, Path Traversal, Hardcoded Secrets/Keys, Insecure Shell/Eval, Unsafe Blocks) across Rust, JS/TS, Python, Go, and Shell. Performs offline SCA dependency vulnerability audit against 283,000+ indexed advisories (CVE/GHSA/OSV) for Cargo.lock, package.json, requirements.txt, and go.mod. Evaluates runtime posture and returns health score.
